app.title: GanttChart
app.subtitle: QA Test Execution Schedule Tracker
dashboard.title: QA Execution Dashboard
dashboard.confirmReset:
Reset "{name}" to demo data?

The active project's inputs (execution counts, planning rows and name) will be replaced with demo data.
This action cannot be undone unless you have a backup.
hint.plannedFinish: Projected from team capacity and the daily plan (not from today's pace). Working days only — weekends and Japan public holidays are skipped. Daily overtime extends each day past 17:30; the deadline itself stays at 17:30.
hint.forecastFinish: Projected if today's execution pace continues until the work is done.
hint.buffer: Deadline minus the planned finish. Positive = time to spare before the deadline.
hint.scheduleVariance: Target finish time minus the forecast finish (pace-based). Positive = ahead.
hint.qaTested: Pass + Fail + N/A. Excludes cases transferred to the SPO side.
hint.qaCompleted: Pass + Fail + N/A + SPO assigned. This completed count drives the schedule.
hint.qaTestedRatio: Tested (excl. SPO) divided by total cases.
hint.qaCompletedRatio: Completed cases divided by total cases.
hint.requiredTesters: Testers needed to finish the remaining cases by the deadline.
hint.requiredHours: Pure execution time needed for the remaining cases.
hint.actualRate: Cases completed per productive hour so far today.
hint.currentRate: Cases completed per productive hour so far today.
hint.requiredRate: Pace needed to finish the remaining cases by the target finish time.
hint.capacityShortage: Cases that cannot be completed before the deadline.
hint.extraDays: Additional working days needed beyond the planned days.
hint.recommended: Testers needed across the planned days to meet the target.
hint.vsTarget: Planned completion minus the target. Positive = ahead of the target.
hint.progress: Completed cases divided by total cases.
hint.plannedProgress: Where progress should be by now at the planned pace.
hint.dailyOvertime: Extra working minutes added to every day after 17:30 — including today. The deadline comparison stays at 17:30, so overtime shows as reduced delay.
timeline.title: Timeline
whatIf.title: What-If: Tester Count
whatIf.hint: Click a row to apply that tester count
plan.staffingHint: Available = max(0, planned − absent). Weekends and Japan public holidays are automatically non-working. Work hours, lunch and per-hour rate are shared with the Input section.
errors.windowOrder: End time must be after the start time.
errors.targetBeforeStart: Must be on or after Start Time
errors.lunchOrder: Lunch End must be after Lunch Start
errors.lunchWindow: Lunch must be inside the work window
errors.startAfterLunch: Plan Start Time must be at or before the lunch break start (12:00)
errors.planDateOrder: Must be after the previous row
explanation.shortage: {capacity} cases can be completed during regular working hours before the deadline. {remaining} cases remain, resulting in a shortage of {shortage} cases.
explanation.feasible: {capacity} cases can be completed during regular working hours before the deadline. All {total} cases finish by {finish}, {buffer} ahead of the deadline.
explanation.late: All {total} cases finish on {finish}, {overrun} after the deadline {deadline}.
explanation.noTarget: {capacity} cases can be completed during regular working hours across the {days} planned days. No deadline is set.
explanation.allDone: All {total} test cases are already complete.
dailyReport.title: Daily Report
dailyReport.copyFromEntriesHint: A daily execution entry exists for this date — use the ⟳ button on a row to copy its counts into the report (edits stay report-local).
dailyReport.activitiesLocalHint: These counts are report-owned copies — they never modify the plan or execution data.
dailyReport.editRevisionHint: Editing creates a revision draft — the finalized original stays archived. Re-finalize to publish the corrected version.
dailyReport.noMembers: No attendance records for this date.
dailyReport.noActivities: No activities. Use Refresh Data to seed from the current plan, or add them manually.
dailyReport.finalizeConfirm: Finalize this report? The snapshot becomes immutable. Use "Create Revision" afterwards to change it.
dailyReport.refreshConfirm: Refresh replaces auto-seeded activities and suggested next-day items. Manually added entries are kept.
dailyReport.confirmDeleteDraft: Delete this draft? Finalized reports are not affected.
dailyReport.popupBlocked: The print window was blocked. Allow pop-ups for this site to export as PDF.
dailyReport.finalizedExistsTitle: A finalized report exists for this date
dailyReport.finalizedExistsBody: View the finalized report, or create a new draft to edit this date.
dailyReport.jiraFallbackHint: If left empty, the project JIRA URL from Settings is used in the report.
dailyReport.deleteDraftHint: Delete this draft (finalized reports are kept)
dailyReport.morningScheduleHint: Seeded from the current plan — add, remove and reorder items freely.
dailyReport.morningRefreshConfirm: Refresh replaces the auto-seeded schedule item. Manually added items are kept.
columns.name: Name
columns.title: Title
attendance.noAbsences: No absences recorded — all members are attending.
attendance.absenceOnlyHint: Record absences only — members without a record count as attending.
attendance.identityUnresolved: Unresolved identity — no member matches this name
attendance.timeInvalid: Working end must be after working start
morning.absentWithReason: ※{name} will be absent for the entire day due to {reason}.
morning.absentWithoutReason: ※{name} will be absent for the entire day.
morning.paidLeaveWithReason: ※{name} will be on paid leave for the entire day ({reason}).
morning.paidLeaveWithoutReason: ※{name} will be on paid leave for the entire day.
morning.otherWithReason: ※{name} will be absent for the entire day ({reason}).
suggestion.capacityRisk: Capacity shortage of {shortage} cases by the deadline — overtime or additional testers required
settings.title: Settings
settings.holidays: Extra holidays (one YYYY-MM-DD per line) — weekends and Japan public holidays are always excluded automatically
reports.title: Reports & Export
reports.backupWarning: Importing a backup replaces ALL current data. A backup of the current data will be downloaded first. Continue?
reports.importWriteErr: The restored data could not be written to local storage. Nothing was changed.
reports.confirmRestore: Restore this backup? {projects} projects and {reports} reports will replace the current data. A backup of the current data is downloaded first.
reports.dateRangeInvalid: The end date is before the start date.
reports.workbookFilterNote: Note: date/team/status filters apply to the report-based sheets; project and member sheets always contain all data.
overall.title: Overall
overall.noProjects: No projects match the current filters.
gantt.activeHiddenByFilter: The active project is hidden by the current filter.
gantt.noProjectsMatch: No projects match the current filter.
gantt.chart.title: Schedule Overview
gantt.chart.hint: Bars run start → deadline; the fill shows progress. Click a bar or name to edit that project.
gantt.chart.noDates: Set a start date and deadline to see the schedule bars.
exec.entryDateHelp: Defaults to today; past days stay editable.
exec.uncategorizedHint: Completed cases that fit no status (Pass / Fail / N/A / SPO).
exec.confirmDeleteEntry: Delete the execution entry for {date}? All cumulative totals and snapshots are recomputed from the remaining days.
exec.dayCountsHelp: Counts are for the selected DAY only (not cumulative). The cumulative totals below and every schedule calculation update automatically.
exec.clampedHint: A total below the previous day's cumulative was clamped to 0 for the day.
exec.entriesHint: One entry per day; editing a past day recomputes all cumulative totals.
statusExplain.title: Why this status?
gap.title: Plan vs Actual — Daily Progress
gap.enterExecutionNotice: Execution results are entered on the Operator view (Today's Execution).
gap.snapshotHint: Actuals come from the daily execution entries (Dashboard → Today's Execution). Toggle a row to MANUAL to fix its plan values.
gap.toggleModeHint: Toggle this day between AUTO (calculated) and MANUAL (your values survive recalculation).
gap.noPlan: No planning rows yet — add days in the Gantt screen.
blocking.title: QA Blocking / Lost Time
milestones.title: Milestones
milestones.name: Name
milestones.autoHint: Actual times are stamped automatically when the target percentage is reached.
milestones.empty: No milestones configured. Add one to track Execute/Pass progress.
recovery.title: Recovery Analysis
recovery.confirmNote: Only Testers and Execution Rate update the project. Additional time and blocking reduction are simulation-only.
recovery.noRecovery: No evaluated scenario reaches the target finish.
recovery.simulationNote: This is a simulation and has not changed the actual project.
errors.targetDateBeforeStart: Target date must be on or after the start date
errors.lunchIncomplete: Set both lunch start and end, or leave both empty
errors.spoMin: SPO assigned count must be 0 or greater
errors.spoExceedsCompleted: SPO assigned count cannot exceed completed cases
errors.passedExceedsTested: Passed cases cannot exceed QA-tested cases (completed minus SPO assigned)
errors.statusCountMin: Status counts must be 0 or greater
errors.statusCountsExceedCompleted: Completed cases must be at least Pass + Fail + N/A + SPO assigned
newProject.title: New Project
newProject.fixedWorkdayHint: Each day works the configured Start–End window; a taken interval (12:00–13:00) is deducted from the productive hours. Days can override these values individually in the Gantt plan.
plan.recalcHint: AUTO values recalculate when project parameters change. MANUAL rows are preserved.
exec.qaCompletedHelp: QA Completed = Pass + Fail + N/A + SPO対応 (SPO Assigned)
exec.statusesHelp: Blocked / Retest / Question (質問中) are informational open-status counts — they do not affect completion, remaining cases or the schedule.
risk.title: Open execution statuses
history.title: Execution History
history.empty: No execution snapshots recorded yet. Use “Snapshot Today” to record the current execution state.
history.inconsistent: Granular counts do not add up to the recorded completion total (uncategorized completed cases)
history.granularUnavailable: Granular status not recorded at this date
history.completionResults: Completion Results (Pass / Fail / N/A / SPO対応)
history.openStatuses: Open / Risk Status (Blocked / Retest / 質問中)
persistence.corruptionBody: Some stored data was unreadable, so the app started from safe defaults. The original data was preserved under a local recovery key — use Import to restore a backup.
persistence.fallbackBody: The browser database is unavailable, so data is being saved to local browser storage instead. All data stays on this machine.
persistence.migrationFailedBody: The move to the browser database did not finish, so the app keeps using local browser storage. Your data was preserved and the migration will be retried on the next start.
persistence.migrationReason.invalidLocal: The saved local data did not pass validation
persistence.migrationReason.writeFailed: Writing to the browser database failed
persistence.migrationReason.verification: The database read-back did not match after writing
persistence.migrationReason.integrityFai: The workspace failed the integrity check
persistence.migrationReason.staleFallbac: The local copy is older than the last database revision
persistence.recoveryBody: The local database is unavailable. A previous local copy exists, but it may not contain your latest changes. The copy has been kept and opened as the best available data — newer data cannot be restored automatically.
persistence.recoveredBody: A newer local copy was detected and restored to the local database. Please review your data.
history.title: Revision History
history.restoreConfirm:
Restore revision {revision}?

A NEW revision will be created with the state of revision {revision}. Newer history is kept and nothing is deleted.
history.recoveryComplete: Recovery completed — revision {revision} now holds the state of revision {restoredFrom}.
history.noHistory: No revision history yet — the first committed change will appear here.
history.unavailable: Revision history is unavailable in the current storage mode.
history.preview: Preview of changes when restoring this revision
history.loadFailed: The revision history could not be read.
history.restoreFailed: The revision could not be restored.
overall.confirmDeleteProject:
Delete "{name}"?

This will remove the project and its local execution data.
This action cannot be undone unless you have a backup.
import.invalidFile: Import failed — the selected file is not a valid GanttChart backup.
import.confirmBackup: Restore this backup? All current local data (projects, reports and settings) will be replaced.
import.confirmProject: Import project "{name}" with {count} report(s)? It will be added as a new project.
import.confirmAppState: Import this project data? It will replace the data of the currently active project.
settings.autoBackupHint: Writes a full-workspace backup file automatically on the first app start of each day. The backup is the same file as the manual Export Backup.
settings.autoBackupNoFolder: No folder selected — backups are downloaded to the browser's Downloads folder.
settings.autoBackupDownloadsNote: This browser does not support choosing a folder (Chrome/Edge required). Backups are downloaded to the Downloads folder instead.
settings.autoBackupRetentionHint: The app's own dated backup files older than this are removed from the backup folder when a new one is written. Other files are never touched.
settings.autoBackupRunNowErr: The backup file could not be written.
autoBackup.needsPermissionBody: After a browser restart, the backup folder must be re-confirmed once. Your data is safe — only the automatic backup file is affected.
autoBackup.failedBody: The daily backup file could not be written. Create one manually via Reports & Export → Export Backup.
settings.dangerZoneHint: Destructive operations that cannot be undone without a backup.
settings.confirmClearAll:
Clear all local GanttChart data?

All projects, reports, planning data and local settings will be removed.
settings.holidaysLinesDropped: {count} invalid holiday lines were ignored (expected YYYY-MM-DD).
settings.clearAllDone: All local data has been cleared.
settings.clearAllAborted: Nothing was deleted: a recovery snapshot of your data could not be saved (browser storage may be full). Download a backup, free up space, then try again.
settings.storageMigrationFailed: not completed — retried on next start
tickets.title: Tickets
tickets.noTickets: No tickets recorded for this project yet.
tickets.duplicateWarning: A ticket with the same key or URL already exists ({key}).
tickets.noActiveProject: No active project. Tickets are filed against the active project.
performance.title: Performance
performance.noData: No performance data for the selected period.
performance.attributionHint: These records attribute the active project's execution per tester. Project totals are entered on the Dashboard (Today's Execution) and are never changed here.
performance.consistencyOk: Tester records match the daily execution entries.
performance.consistencyMismatch: Tester records differ from the daily execution entries:
performance.noDailyRecords: No daily execution records for the active project yet.
errors.casesTestedMin: Cases tested must be 0 or more.
errors.countInvalid: Enter a number of 0 or more
errors.assignmentEndBeforeStart: End date must be on or after the start date.
errors.memberEndBeforeStart: End date must be on or after the start date.
errors.nameHistoryDuplicate: This name already exists in the history
errors.nameHistoryCurrentDuplicate: Equals the current name — remove this entry
errors.nameHistoryDateOrder: End date is before start date
members.title: RCS Members
members.subtitle: Member master with stable identities — the member ID never changes
members.name: Name
members.confirmDelete: Delete this member? Historical records are not affected.
members.referencedCannotDelete:
Member {id} is referenced by historical records (attendance, assignments, tickets, execution or reviews). Deleting would destroy those identity references.

Deactivate this member instead? Historical data is never deleted.
identityResolution.title: Identity Resolution
identityResolution.description: Legacy records whose recorded name could not be confidently matched to one member. Choose a member explicitly — nothing is resolved automatically.
identityResolution.reasonHistoryUnrestri: Historical name "{name}" matches with no date restriction.
identityResolution.matchHistoryValid: Historical name valid on the record date
identityResolution.matchOutsideRange: Historical name outside its valid range on the record date
identityResolution.confirmBulk: Apply the {selected} selected unique suggestion(s) now? Ambiguous records without a suggestion ({ambiguous}) are never resolved automatically.
identityResolution.bulkSummary: Selected {selected} of {suggested} suggested · {ambiguous} ambiguous without a suggestion.
performance.allocationDescription: Adjust the proposed allocation per member for a day. The attendance-aware suggestion splits the executed total among attending testers; the remainder is shown as unassigned. Edited allocations are saved as manual overrides that sync never overwrites.
performance.allocationSuggestedNone: No attending testers — verify before applying
performance.allocationNoDates: No dates with executed cases and assigned testers for the active project.
allocation.overAllocated: Allocated total exceeds the project total for: {metrics}.
allocation.unsupportedMetric: No source data — the allocation must stay 0 for: {metrics}.
allocation.memberOverlap: {member}: completed categories ({sum}) exceed their tested total ({cases}).
review.title: Bonus Review
review.subtitle: Objective evidence for supervisor evaluation
review.noReviews: No reviews recorded for this tester yet.
review.noData: No objective data for this tester in the selected period.
review.selectTester: Select a tester to view the review evidence.
review.disclaimer: This workspace presents objective evidence only. Bonus amounts, ratings and rankings are decided by the supervisor.
review.confirmDelete: Delete this review? The objective data is not affected.
performance.syncDescription: Derives tester daily records from the daily execution snapshots and the tester assignments below. Assigned totals are proposed as an equal split and can be corrected at any time; manual corrections are preserved.
performance.syncNoChanges: No records to create or update.
performance.syncUnassigned: Days with execution but no tester assignment: {count}
performance.confirmRemoveRecord: Remove this daily execution record? This cannot be undone.
performance.noActiveProject: No active project. Select or create a project first.
performance.attendanceAbsent: Attendance says absent ({status}), but {cases} cases are recorded.
performance.assignmentNone: No testers assigned to this project yet.
